Angle follows20%of wrapped angular error each source update. Row event adds6+3*U velocity along current direction; end controller friction retention0.95. Walk20frames with Row6; returns ready when animation ends. State6 handles thrown arrival and is not ordinary rowing.

evidence_corrections: First animation request used resources/gfx keys. The correct Repentance metadata uses resources-dlc3/gfx; the corrected extraction retrieves both records from the pinned repentance.a archive.
Initial build command used a nonexistent target deathward_mechanics_check. Correct target is deathward_check_mechanics; failed log retained.
Initial compile warned about same-line unconditional returns after stun recovery checks. Formatting was corrected without changing the intended control flow before final builds.

The loader originally prohibited every replacement on grouped entries. Deterministic all-birth replacement cannot split a group, so only replace_spawn is now exempt. Random replace_monster still rejects grouped entries; the new fixture explicitly verifies that rejection.

The real fireplace comparison failed because EnvironmentActors constructed a temporary contact Hazard with its default delay1 and immediately tested it at age0; it could never expose nearby monsters. Set delay0 for this immediate contact check. The fixture now compares actual source33contact against ordinary Spider and Swarm, and separately checks Flame/Burning damage remains effective.

The first WASM cover scene used a flight fixture that deliberately spawned its actor inside a crate. Strider obeys solid collision and could not move. The debug scene now starts this ground actor outside cover; the original failed browser report and image are retained.

Native visual inspection found Strider generic short legs floating with its lifted body. Its leg tips now extend down by the visual lift; the source-derived body height and physical collider are unchanged. Both before and corrected captures are retained.

The first full native run passed69of72. The stage eligibility assertion only followed phase0 replacements, missing the new deterministic phase3. It now enumerates legal outcomes across all4phases and correctly removes impossible unreplaced outcomes for100%rules.

The Eggy fixture assumed a smaller Swarm collision radius. Installed ordinary Spider and Swarm both use radius13, so it now checks source-equal colliders and the distinct Swarm controller; the smaller Swarm artwork remains.

The pacing fixture found a flying Mr.Maw Head35.1 at seed1/ShortCorridors/Canyon/room8 validly spawned above low scenery. It had incorrectly applied the walking mask. It now checks the flying collision mask and supporting height for actual flyers, retaining the walking check for ground actors.
